items.event_time_ist: Evening of Saturday, Oct 10, 2026 (newly reported Oct 12-13)
items.summary: The IRGC Navy issued repeated 'serious warning' broadcasts on marine Channel 16 ordering vessels at anchor in Oman's Khasab harbor (Musandam peninsula), Mina Saqr, and Ras al Khaimah (UAE) to weigh anchor and 'go back to Dubai anchorage'. Ambrey said six commercial ships anchored ~16.5 nm off Ras al Khaimah were told Saturday evening to leave immediately; UKMTO logged the incident as 'suspicious activity' (security notice 161-26) without identifying the sender. Omani authorities normally jam IRGC transmissions aimed at vessels in Omani waters, but this one got through; some ships complied and headed west. Separately, Iran declared a prohibited area covering all of Oman's territorial waters off the Musandam peninsula (map first aired on Al Jazeera Arabic) — assessed as a response to the US 'Project Freedom' escort posture. A particular threat to Oman, whose Musandam fishing communities have no road access and depend on resupply by ship.
items.title: IRGC Navy ordered anchored ships in Omani and Emirati waters to relocate via VHF, widening its maritime control zone
